items.title: File Fairfax County business personal property return
items.authority: Fairfax County Department of Tax Administration
items.description: Virginia business tangible personal property returns are filed with the locality's commissioner of the revenue for property held January 1; deadlines are set locally (commonly May 1). Filing is due May 1 (the next business day if it falls on a weekend); payment is due October 5 and no payment is due at filing.
